newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks open lower after bond market drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks open lower after bond market drop.

text.p: Wall Street stocks moved sharply lower at the opening on Tuesday following a morning selloff in the bond market after stronger-than-expected November housing starts data surprised economists.
The Dow Jones industrial average was off 19 at 6,248, the Nasdaq Composite down nine at 1,252 and the S&P Index off two to 718.
The 30-year bond was down 27/32 to yield 6.69 percent.
